steps.sql: CREATE TABLE cf_background_job (job_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin PRIMARY KEY,kind VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL,actor VARCHAR(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,actor_kind VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL,scope_type VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL,scope_id TEXT COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,scope_hash CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL,request_digest CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL,idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL,request_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL,step VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL,attempts INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,lease_owner VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET ascii NULL,lease_expiry DATETIME(6) NULL,lease_epoch BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,barrier_active TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,next_attempt_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,checkpoint LONGTEXT NULL,result_ref TEXT NULL,error_code VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii NULL,created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,UNIQUE KEY job_idempotency(actor,actor_kind,kind,idempotency_key),KEY job_pending(status,next_attempt_at,lease_expiry),KEY job_barrier(scope_type,scope_hash,barrier_active)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
